about.title: Artemis
about.section1: Artemis is a free application developed by a non-profit organization dedicated to raising awareness and protecting endangered animal and plant species.
about.section2: Our goal is to make scientific information about biodiversity accessible through a playful and educational approach, allowing everyone to discover the fascinating world of nature.
about.section3: We collaborate with nature conservation associations and scientific institutions to ensure the reliability and quality of our content.
about.section4: Artemis is based on the belief that knowledge is the first step towards preservation. By exploring this application, you contribute to supporting efforts to conserve our natural heritage.

partner.title: Our partners
partner.introLine1: Our application is based on a central objective: to provide reliable, educational and accessible information about animal species and their conservation.
partner.introLine2: To ensure the accuracy and quality of our content, we collaborate with nature conservation organizations and engaged actors, who support us in accessing essential scientific data: estimated populations, habitat areas, conservation status and field actions.
partner.introLine3: These partnerships make it possible to enrich the application while valuing the work of organizations committed to biodiversity.
partner.lpoTitle: LPO  French League for Bird Protection
partner.lpoDesc1: The LPO is a leading French organization dedicated to bird protection, biodiversity and natural habitats. It works through field actions, scientific monitoring programs and public awareness missions.
partner.lpoDesc2: As part of this partnership, the LPO helps strengthen the reliability of information about bird species in the application, particularly regarding their conservation status, geographic distribution and threats. The application in turn highlights LPO's work and promotes its protection initiatives.
partner.zooDesc1: ZooParc de Beauval is a major animal conservation player, recognized for its commitment to many breeding programs and endangered species rescue programs.
partner.zooDesc2: As part of this partnership, the application highlights certain species present at the park through educational content and immersive experience, particularly through 3D animal visualization accessible via a scanning system. Dedicated QR codes can be provided to visitors to enhance their discovery and better understand the conservation challenges led by ZooParc de Beauval.
partner.wwfTitle: WWF  World Wide Fund for Nature
partner.wwfDesc1: The WWF is one of the world's largest nature conservation organizations. Its work aims to preserve biodiversity, reduce human impact on ecosystems and encourage more sustainable lifestyles.
partner.wwfDesc2: This partnership makes it possible to integrate reliable data and information about threatened species on a global scale into the application, as well as on current major environmental issues. The application content also participates in raising public awareness of WWF's actions and campaigns.

codeDuVivant.title: Code of Life
codeDuVivant.description: Discover the fascinating world of taxonomy and the scientific names of animals.
codeDuVivant.intro: Discover the fascinating world of taxonomy and the scientific names of animals. Observe the animal and choose the correct scientific name from four options. After each answer, discover its meaning and improve your knowledge.
